script_text: The ocean is about to swallow the shore, Pisces, and this week you will feel the tide turn against you. On Monday and Tuesday, Mercury squares Neptune in your twelfth house, stirring foggy dreams and hidden fears before Wednesday. That is why Tuesday is your worst day, because that aspect blurs your intuition. Midweek, Jupiter trines your ruling planet Neptune, the water element, in your twelfth house, a gentle shift. From Thursday onward, Mars opposes your seventh house, shaking partnerships or sparking attraction. Your love life gets a second chance, but only if you speak your truth. In career and money, Mercury conjunct your tenth house of reputation asks for honest self-promotion. The weekend brings calm as the moon completes its cycle. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth house. Speak your truth before the fog returns, Pisces. Follow for daily updates.
